SR2E.Text.Inlinetest.usage: Usage: /sr2 <attribute | skill | perception | dice> [tn N] [mod ±M] [pool N] [secret] [label text], e.g. /sr2 Firearms tn 5 mod -1 (secret: only the GM sees the card)
SR2E.Card.Hidden.tnForTheGm: The target number is for the GM to know.
SR2E.App.Settings.privacyGmHint: First list: your own default. Second list: the table's default for everyone; a player can only make those cards more private, never less. This hides cards on screen; it isn't security.
SR2E.App.Settings.privacyPlayerHint: Your GM may set a table default for some kinds of test: you can only make those cards more private.
SR2E.Settings.hideNpcNumbers.Name: Hide NPC target numbers from players
SR2E.Settings.hideNpcNumbers.Hint: On the cards of tests no player owns, players see the successes but not the target number or its modifiers. This hides them on screen; it isn't security.
SR2E.Settings.floatingDamageWho.Name: Who sees floating damage
SR2E.Settings.floatingDamageWho.Hint: Floating damage numbers over tokens: only the GM and the token's owners, or everyone. They wait for Dice So Nice's dice to stop.
The GM and the token's owners
Everyone who can see the token
